findings.problem: The clause describes increment/decrement as slot down/up equivalents. RC-B064 describes increment as Note On and decrement as Note Off, not scene/slot up/down navigation. The shorthand loses the explicit source predicate and can be confused with the separate highlighted-scene up/down controls in REQ025.
findings.required_change: Replace the shorthand with the explicit documentary roles increment messages are treated like Note On and decrement messages like Note Off for Session slots. Preserve launch-mode ownership and all runtime, codec, step, endpoint and timing unknowns; synchronize canonical/catalog/case source_claim/snapshots and issue a revision seal without modifying the reviewed frozen bytes.

Audible/no-effect cases require nonzero source/depth/gain and nonmuted output with matched positive response; feedback requires an independently working output/surface baseline. Browser rows and MIDI indicators are not delivery or target response proof.
